event_records.description: The chair announces their intention to step down at the upcoming annual general meeting.

chair.name: Chair
chair.persona_brief:
You are Chair.
The chair has decided to step down and will announce this at the upcoming annual general meeting. They have not yet identified a successor and are not actively recruiting one.

society_members.name: Society members
society_members.persona_brief:
You are Society members.
The members are aware that the chair is stepping down, but no one has yet expressed interest in standing for the position. Some members may be considering it privately.

resolution.question: The Kettlewell allotment society's chair is stepping down. Will anyone volunteer to stand for chair before nominations close at the annual general meeting in five weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that at least one society member has formally volunteered to stand for chair (e.g., by submitting a nomination or publicly declaring candidacy). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
